name: flight-makes-one-departure-not-two
description: A flight is a travel leg, not a travel leg plus a hand-written 'Depart ORD' point. The departure/arrival points are generated from the leg; the model must not author its own or the timeline shows every flight twice.
requirement: app.enums.DERIVED_POINT_TYPES — detail_points.py is the single writer
message: I fly out of O'Hare at 9am on Oct 30 and land at Naha airport at 2:30pm.
